succubus: Having walked the pilgrim roads in a pilgrim's robe, the Succubus was the only one of the latest batch to reach the hamlet.
voivode: Having flown in his Strigoi form under cover of night, the Voivode simply shows up in the Hamlet unannounced, waiting in courtly shape in the room before the Margrave and Bursar arrive.
slayer: The Slayer does not arrive at all. His casket was stolen for the Ancestor long ago. Write his finding into being brought from a recent dungeon.
fawn: The Fawn wanders out of the Warrens and into the hamlet, the first people she's met (except the Ancestor).
duchess: The Duchess walks out of the Courtyard and down into the Hamlet, cast out by the Crimson Court.
maid: Having crossed from the far east by ship, the Maid arrives at the Hamlet by the same route her Mistress took west, and never came back along.
meister: Having followed the Drowned Crew west from Haenara by sea, the Meister arrives by boat.
krakenslayer: Having swum here, the Krakenslayer walks into the Hamlet still dripping.
ringmaster: Having brought her caravan to the Hamlet a few months after the Heirs, the Ringmaster has been running the Butcher's Circus here ever since, and only now asks/is asked to join.
aesthete: Having travelled in his own carriage with his household in tow, the Aesthete arrives with an entourage of bird-folk servants.
rampart: Far too heavy for any coach, the Rampart walked the Old Road on foot.
dredge: With her machine far too heavy to load onto a stagecoach, the Dredge walks it the whole way.
librarian: Having come home rather than arrived, the Librarian walks into a Hamlet she grew up in.
thrall: The Thrall is delivered rather than recruited, arriving with papers bearing the Estate's seal, addressed to the Heirs or whoever now holds it.
